An '''iron sword''' is the [[Iron equipment|iron]] [[Weapons#Sword|sword]], crafted from two [[iron ingot]]s and a stick. It deals {{Hp|6}} damage and is the base for the [[steel sword]], [[steel claymore]], [[silver sword]] and [[warding sword]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The iron swords in [[Abbey]] barracks and tower chests are a separate variant: they carry [[Anemos]] I and set only an attack damage modifier, so they have no attack cooldown even though their tooltip shows 1.6.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/abbey/barracks.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|6}} damage at an attack speed of 1.6 and has 500 durability. It hits one harder than the [[copper sword]] and one softer than the [[diamond sword]].

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into a single iron ingot, and at a [[smithing table]] it takes [[steel alloy]] to become its [[Steel equipment|steel]] counterpart.
